invariants.name: invariant_00_tripwire_annihilationActuallyHappened
invariants.description: Once the settlement path has been attempted >=5 times, at least one annihilation must have settled. Abort-on-empty.

invariants.name: invariant_01_noRecordedViolations
invariants.description: Surfaces per-call property violations recorded by the handler (the handler records rather than reverts, because fail_on_revert=false would swallow a reverting handler call).

invariants.name: invariant_1_soleBurn_supplyEqualsMintedMinusAnnihilated
invariants.description: INV1 SOLE-BURN. totalSupply == ghostMinted - ghostBurnedByAnnihilate; per call the caller's balance and supply each fall by exactly `amount` and no other holder's balance moves.

invariants.name: invariant_2_noThirdPartyPower_noStandingPull
invariants.description: INV2 / H-01 (033432b0e6). No actor's stablecoin moves except the acting caller's own; Antimatter never carries a standing stable allowance to the minter.

invariants.name: invariant_3_wholeOrNothing_noResidue
invariants.description: INV3. Antimatter holds zero stablecoin and zero phUSD beyond ghost-tracked outright donations, and the stable allowance to the minter is zero, after every success and every revert.

invariants.name: handler:_req INV4/INV5
invariants.description: INV4 CONSERVATION and INV5 QUOTE-EQUALITY, checked per successful call: recipient phUSD delta == amount + calculateMintAmount(stable, toStableAmount(stable, amount)); caller antimatter delta == amount; caller stablecoin delta == toStableAmount(stable, amount).

invariants.name: invariant_6_decimalsCrosscheck_understatedNeverSettles
invariants.description: INV6 / M-01 (a1c81428a4). A stablecoin whose registered decimals understate (or overstate) its real decimals() can never be annihilated.

invariants.name: invariant_7_rescueStaysOwnerOnly
invariants.description: rescueERC20 stayed owner-only across the campaign.

invariants.name: invariant_8_dailyCapGovernsAllIssuance / invariant_9_minterCapChargedForFullIssuance
invariants.description: Run-01 invariant_09/invariant_10, ported unchanged. phUSD issued per stable in a rolling 24h window must not exceed maxMintPerDay, and the minter must charge its cap for the full issuance. EXPECTED TO FAIL: reproduces ledger findings M-03 / M-05.

retiredByDesignChange.name: invariant_06_noStableSpentBeyondCallerAllowance
retiredByDesignChange.reason: Quantifies over a (caller, from) pair with caller != from. `annihilateFrom` no longer exists at c91bc1a; `annihilate` sources both halves from msg.sender and has no `from` parameter. Rewriting it with from == msg.sender would make it trivially true and would silently replace the property that mattered.

retiredByDesignChange.name: invariant_07_noValueRedirectedAwayFromOwner
retiredByDesignChange.reason: Same. Its surviving intent is carried, in a different and stronger form, by invariant_2 plus the handler's per-call _assertOnlyCallerStableMoved leg.
